lessons: Keep the BugEvidence gate, its Check-set wiring in stages.py, the repo-relative carries lint in tickets.py, and every existing test in tests/test_bug_gate.py. Review found one fixable gap. Do not touch merge.py or any path outside the fence.

Fix at squatch/stages.py ~540: `git diff --name-only base...branch` also lists paths the branch deleted, and no `carries` prefix can ever cover them. Before computing `uncovered`, drop changed paths that are missing from the branch workspace. Intersect with the ls_files(workspace) result.
Fetch ls_files(workspace) once and reuse it for both `_carried_paths` and the filter on changed paths, so there is a single source of truth for what exists on the branch.

Add a test to tests/test_bug_gate.py where the branch renames a test: the old path appears in `changed`, is present at base and absent on the branch, and the new path is carried. Assert the gate passes. The ReplayGit stub already takes an arbitrary `changed` tuple.

Keep the fail-closed rule for every branch-added path that is not carried. Only deleted paths get exempted. Rerun all three verification commands. run.md `## Outcome` must be a single closed value such as `ok`.
reason: The review snag is one concrete in-fence fix with a clear paved road (filter deleted paths out of `changed` and add a rename test); the rest of the diff was judged sound.
